signal.degradedTitle: Upstream is recovering. Requests remain held.
signal.unknownTitle: Waiting for the first upstream signal.
signal.healthyDescription: Requests are moving through Relay-Lifeline to the configured relay without interruption.
signal.degradedDescription: Active connections stay open. Relay-Lifeline will retry according to policy without changing the request.
signal.unknownDescription: The gateway is online and will assess upstream health on the next request.
signal.staticFallback: Live rendering unavailable; operational data remains current
signal.topologyLabel: Live route from Codex through Relay-Lifeline to the configured upstream

charts.unavailable: Chart rendering is unavailable; operational controls remain active

priority.title: Current situation
priority.stableDescription: Relay-Lifeline is healthy and the upstream path is available or standing by.
priority.pausedDescription: Existing request state is preserved and processing will continue under the current policy after resume.

advice.paused: Resume request intake after confirming the maintenance window has ended.
advice.incident: Review the dominant error category, then watch the next recovery attempt.
advice.waiting: Keep the client connection open and do not submit a duplicate request.
advice.request: The request is progressing normally; no intervention is needed yet.
advice.alert: Open the related request or incident and confirm the alert is still actionable.
advice.stable: The path is stable; keep the current policy and continue observing.

alerts.title: Risk alerts
alerts.description: Alerts do not change the active retry policy

recent.title: Active requests
recent.description: Requests currently processing or waiting to recover

queue.title: Request queue
queue.description: All active connections and requests waiting to retry
